Near Home.title: Litter pick
Near Home.summary: Join us for a Saturday afternoon litter pick. All welcome and all equipment provided. Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.

Near Home.summary: Join us for a guided walk and nature journaling workshop held in the Kenwood Estate . Near Home.title: Kenwood Tree Walk
Near Home.summary: Join us for a guided walk to discover more about the trees of the Kenwood Estate and learn how to identify them in Autumn. The walk will start in the Kenwood area area (book on for the exact meeting point) and will last for about an hour and a half. Please note, we will be walking across some slightly uneven and muddy terrain. This walk is free of charge - donations welcome ! Book here

Near Home.title: Family creative walk
Near Home.summary: Join us for a family-friendly guided creative walk. Our artist in residence, Shilpa Agashe, will lead the walk and will encourage everyone to observe flowers, plants and wildlife and draw, paint, write or take photos in response to what you see. This walk will start outside, ending inside with hot chocolate! All materials provided (though you’re welcome to bring a favourite notebook if you like!).
